signup.title: Get alerts about lost dogs in your area
signup.intro: No passwords. No app. No profile to maintain. Just an email whenever a pet goes missing or is found near your shelter. You can unsubscribe with one click whenever you like.

features.alert: An email when someone raises a lost dog alert in your area
features.zone: You set the area with a postcode and a coverage radius
features.closed: Another email when the alert is closed, so no cases are left hanging

optIns.legend: What would you like to receive?
optIns.overflow: Also include alerts up to 50 km away (extended area)
optIns.digest: Daily digest (a single email a day with all cases)

signup.consent: By signing up you agree to receive emails about lost pet alerts in your area. You can unsubscribe with one click at any time. We comply with the GDPR: see our <privacyLink>privacy policy</privacyLink> for details.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: We've sent an email to {{email}} to confirm your subscription. Just open it and press the confirmation button.
sent.spam: Can't see it? Check your spam or promotions folder. The sender is {{sender}}.

errors.send: We couldn't send your subscription. Please try again in a minute.
errors.invalidPostcode: That postcode isn't in our database.
errors.invalidRadius: The radius must be between 5 and 100 km.
errors.noOptIn: Please tick at least one of the two alert types.

confirm.okBody: {{name}} will receive an email at {{email}} whenever a pet goes missing or is found in your area.
confirm.okFooter: You can unsubscribe with a single click from any of those emails. Thanks for joining the search network.
confirm.invalidBody: This confirmation link isn't valid or has already been used. If you already had an active subscription, it's still on: you'll keep receiving emails as usual.
confirm.errorBody: We couldn't confirm your subscription right now. Please try again in a minute, or sign up again.

unsubscribe.okBody: {{email}} will no longer receive alerts. Thank you for the time you spent helping to find lost pets.
unsubscribe.okFooter: If this was a mistake or you change your mind, you can sign up again whenever you like.
unsubscribe.invalidBody: This link isn't valid or the subscription had already been cancelled. You won't receive any more emails.
unsubscribe.errorBody: We couldn't process your request right now. Please try again in a minute. If the problem persists, write to us at hola@petpanic.es.
